name: openpnm-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is OpenPNM, a Python framework for pore network modeling of transport in porous
materials: network generators (cubic lattices, Delaunay and Voronoi tessellations) and the `Network` class with its
topological queries, the `topotools` network-manipulation functions, pore-scale models (statistical distributions and
basic math, pore and throat geometry, conduit size factors, and physics such as conductances, capillary pressure and
source terms), and algorithms that solve steady transport problems and simulate invasion and drainage.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules: every module in src/openpnm/network/, src/openpnm/topotools/, src/openpnm/models/misc/, and src/openpnm/models/geometry/ and src/openpnm/models/physics/ with their subpackages; and the algorithm modules src/openpnm/algorithms/_algorithm.py, _transport.py, _stokes_flow.py, _fickian_diffusion.py, _invasion_percolation.py, _drainage.py and _solution.py. Together with them, README.md and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is README.md and the
